notes: 1500 seeded 3-10 vertex star and 2-opt polygons check every interior triangle edge against a brute-force diagonal oracle, require n-3 distinct diagonals and match a naive exact ear clipper triangle-for-triangle.

300 seeded random polygons in both windings check area preservation, positive orientation, index validity, piece convexity, the Hertel-Mehlhorn 2r+1 bound, diagonal maximality and sampled point-in-polygon coverage; outputs are invariant under rotation and reversal.
Fixtures cover concave, collinear, repeated, nearly-degenerate and convex polygons plus every typed error; warmed reuse allocates zero times and star-polygon ear tests stay within 3n.
criterion: Divan polygon2 suite only; no Criterion suite is added.
